streams.label: Recycling
streams.description: Plastic bottles, aluminum cans, clean paper, cardboard, glass bottles. Items must be empty.

streams.label: Compost
streams.description: Food scraps, napkins, paper towels, BPI-certified compostable serviceware.

streams.label: Garbage
streams.description: Chip bags, candy wrappers, styrofoam, plastic wrap, straws, coffee cups, mixed packaging.

streams.label: Liquids Only
streams.description: Pour remaining liquids here before recycling the container.

overrides.note: Empty the bottle first. Pour liquids into the Liquids bin.
Paper coffee cups have a plastic lining and go in garbage. Lids go in garbage too.
Most airport food containers are mixed materials. If marked compostable, use Compost.
